summary: The integration coordinator clarified that Story 18.2 owns shared prepared-source read/root authority and lease lifetime, while Story 18.3 owns CodeGraph-specific writable index placement. The installed CodeGraph 1.5.0 package's directory.js codeGraphDirName/getCodeGraphDir accepts only a single in-project directory segment; absolute, separator and traversal overrides are ignored. CodeGraph init and serve help expose no external index path. Therefore the accepted specification/plan assumption that 18.2 can supply safe writable .codegraph placement is false. Return to spec as earliest owner to identify a safe source-bound disposable workspace approach and its authority; do not write the live root, copy source or execute held physical tasks on the old approval. Preserve completed independent code/evidence. Story 18.2's identifiable verified shared lease checkpoint remains unresolved.
